sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000170-P1, was presented by GSK PHARM (the Supplier) to Silver Oak Medical Group 170 on November 11, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.75%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 80%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
